decisions.reason: As a close-to-core service that reinforces the firm's agency-focused support promise, premium customer support is something management is likely to justify and continue despite any mixed uptake.
The software version management tool builds directly on the firm's hosting platform and was publicly presented as part of its tool set, so prior investment and strategic fit favor persistence.
Although the firm has already invested in and publicly listed this tool, its distance from the core hosting and support business makes it the easiest offering to abandon if results have disappointed.
Scalable hosting for agencies sits at the center of the firm's stated direction, was visible on the home page, and is strongly supported by current industry growth, making withdrawal unlikely.
